notes: Plan-only evals grade strict direct review. Each operation resolves once into a retained ResolvedProject; refusal is fatal and no policy is defaulted or inferred.

evals.name: plan-review-direct-command-and-capability
evals.prompt: At from-issue Phase 5, plan-review is ready. Plan-only: explain selection, direct invocation, validation, failure handling, and disposition.
evals.expected_output: Resolve once into a retained ResolvedProject. Select bindings.workflow.review.plan, capabilities.review.plan, and bindings.commands[review_id]; a refusal is fatal. blocked stops with its reason and repair ID; unsupported takes the documented native route. For available, preserve base argv/cwd/env and append `exec --sandbox read-only --model gpt-6-astra -c model_reasoning_effort="xhigh" --json --output-last-message <absolute-last-message> --ephemeral -C <absolute-worktree> -`, sending the complete packet on stdin. Keep JSONL and last-message candidates under TMPDIR with unconditional cleanup. Validate every JSONL object, selected model gpt-6-astra, selected reasoning effort xhigh, exactly one terminal agent-message, and byte equality with the non-empty last-message before Blocking / Should fix / Discussion establish Codex. A daemon, slot, or capacity rejection stops verbatim with no retry and no native fallback. A completed non-capacity runtime, metadata, output, or schema failure takes exactly one native fallback with the same packet. The parent verifies and dispositions findings without storing the raw transcript.

evals.name: diff-review-light-packet-boundaries
evals.prompt: sdd dispatches diff-review over abc1234..def5678. Plan-only: state the packet, output, route, and disposition.
evals.expected_output: Resolve once into a retained ResolvedProject and select bindings.workflow.review.code, capabilities.review.code, and bindings.commands[review_id]. Refusal is fatal; blocked stops; unsupported takes the documented native route. IN: operation/directory/branch/base/head; correctness-only scope (bugs, boundary handling, dead branches, contract assertions, DRY, integration) explicitly excluding conformance; rubric path with values; manifest root plus all four metrics and plan routing path; verification context and AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md chain; matching standards. OUT deliberately: issue investigation, spec, domain/context docs, planReview focus, and plan-review contract. Invoke base argv/cwd/env plus `exec --sandbox read-only --model gpt-6-astra -c model_reasoning_effort="xhigh" --json --output-last-message <absolute-last-message> --ephemeral -C <absolute-worktree> -`; validate all JSONL, selected model/effort, exactly one terminal agent-message, non-empty last-message byte equality, then Critical / Important / Minor. Output begins Correctness Clean|Findings, has exactly those three sections, <=400 words, stable IDs, live path:line evidence, confidence, unknowns, and None. when empty. Return result unmodified with reviewer identity and scope. Capacity rejection stops verbatim, no retry/native fallback; one completed non-capacity failure gets one same-packet native fallback.

evals.name: diff-review-oversized-range-scoped-packet
evals.prompt: diff-review sees 44 product files. Plan-only: explain scope, direct review validation, and error routes.
evals.expected_output: After selecting bindings.workflow.review.code from one retained ResolvedProject, run the existing size pre-flight with resolved artifact paths. A 44-file range scopes to the first 20 helper entries without filtering/re-ranking. It preserves manifest root/all four metrics but says do not read shards, and adds item 7 with selected root-relative paths and changed-line counts. For each path run exactly one `git diff <base>..<head> -- ':(literal)<path>'`: a single literal argument after --, never shell-joined, pathspec magic disabled; no per-file diffs are embedded. The coverage says 20 of 44, listed files are the only graded files, each finding is anchored in one, and unlisted files may only be consulted as evidence. First line is exactly `**Correctness:** Clean — scoped to 20 of 44 product files; <assessment>` or Findings equivalent; bare/scoped-parenthetical forms fail. Return validated result, reviewer identity, and `scoped: 20 of 44 product files`. Invoke the base command plus exact D7 argv augmentation `exec --sandbox read-only --model gpt-6-astra -c model_reasoning_effort="xhigh" --json --output-last-message <absolute-last-message> --ephemeral -C <absolute-worktree> -`; validate JSONL selected model/effort, one terminal message, last-message bytes, and Critical/Important/Minor. Capacity rejection stops verbatim without retry/native fallback; unavailable measurement is unmeasured; one completed non-capacity runtime/output/schema failure gets same-packet native fallback. No default/inference is allowed.
